C:P1.1.text: Sabre: the open platform powering modern travel

C:P1.2.text: Open, modular, and AI-powered from the ground up. Sabre gives the entire travel industry the tools to retail smarter, distribute further, and build faster.

C:P1.3.text: Technology that takes you wherever you want to go

C:P1.4.text: Open. Modular. Al-native. The success platform for all of travel

C:P1.5.text: Sabre Mosaic ® gives you all the benefits of an enterprise system with all the flexibility of a startup stack.

C:P1.6.text: The widest content, smart automation and revenue controls in one AI-powered platform. Built to grow with you, not hold you back.

C:P1.7.text: One experience, from first search to final change

C:P1.8.text: The fastest path from search to sold

C:P1.9.text: Payments that work harder for you

C:P1.11.text: The intelligence to move faster than the market

C:P1.12.text: Open, modular technology that plays well with other systems. Retail your way to billions of travelers.

C:P1.13.text: From booking to boarding and beyond, the Experience Suite lets travelers own their trip and airlines own the relationship

C:P1.14.text: From where you fly to how you price and bundle, the Retail Suite covers all of it

C:P1.15.text: When every team works from one record, service holds together under any pressure

C:P1.16.text: One suite for pay-in and pay-out, so your team runs payments as a strategy, not a series of workarounds

C:P1.17.text: Remove the blind spots that fragmented data creates to give airlines real visibility. So teams act on what’s happening, not what already happened

C:P1.19.text: We are excited to partner with Sabre to lead the industry in modern airline retailing

C:P1.20.text: Their [Sabre] expertise, innovation, and commitment to excellence make them the ideal partner as we embark on this journey to become the first airline to operate on full offer and order technology.

C:P1.21.text: At Priceline, we are focused on giving consumers access to the best deals, best inventory, and best tools to book their travel. Ensuring that we have access to the broadest air content is a prerequisite to achieving that vision. Sabre’s robust content and technology solutions will help Priceline deliver on our vision for our customers.

C:P1.22.text: What Sabre brings to the table, it’s consistency, it’s being right there for us, helping us problem-solve, and more importantly, helping us continue to push the envelope in terms of innovation. [Sabre’s] been great partners for us. Looking forward to the next ten years with [them].

C:P1.23.text: We started Mindtrip with one clear goal: to make the end-to-end travel journey seamless. In partnership with PayPal and Sabre, we’re realizing that vision. Rather than bouncing between search tools, booking sites and payment screens, travelers will have the ability to discover, plan, book, and pay for a trip in one continuous, intuitive, trusted, conversational experience.

C:P1.24.text: Travel is a highly complex purchase decision for consumers, and ease, speed, and flexibility at checkout matter. This next generation of agentic AI finally connects discovery to decision-making and booking without leaving the experience. By integrating PayPal’s agentic commerce offerings directly into the experience, we’re transforming inspiration into action – giving consumers more choice, control and confidence, while helping partners convert more of the demand they generate.
